<article title="Refund timelines">
Refunds are issued to the original payment method within five business days after the return arrives at our warehouse. Your bank may take a further three to ten business days to show the credit on your statement.

If you chose store credit, it appears in your account as soon as the return is checked in, usually the same day.

Customer first name: Kwabena
<request>
refund timing
the carrier says my return was delivered to you yesterday. when does the money come back?
</request>

Reply:
text:
Hi Kwabena,

Thanks for reaching out! Since your return was delivered to us yesterday, here's our refund timeline:

**For refunds to your original payment method:** We process refunds within five business days after the return arrives at our warehouse. After that, your bank may take an additional three to ten business days to show the credit on your statement.

**For store credit:** This appears in your account as soon as the return is checked in, usually the same day.

If more than 15 business days pass without seeing your refund, please contact us with your order number and we'll check on it with our warehouse.

Best regards,
Fernwood Outfitters Support
